select
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d-%h') as transDay,
DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as transDay,
count(*) as transNum from spu where UNIX_TIMESTAMP(create_time) * 1000 between #{query.createBeginTime} and #{query.createEndTime} group by transDay order by transDay asc

SELECT sum(if(t.inventory = 0 , 1, 0)) as 'stockWarn', sum(if(t.inventory_warning > t.inventory, 1,0)) as 'stockEmpty' FROM sku t LEFT JOIN spu t1 ON t.spu_id = t1.id WHERE t1.account_id = #{supplierId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

select t.*, t1.free_post, t1.name as freight_template_name, min(t2.market_price) as market_price_began, max(t2.market_price) as market_price_end from spu t left join freight_template t1 on t.freight_template_id = t1.id left join sku t2 on t.id = t2.spu_id ${ew.customSqlSegment} group by t.id
